player_prompt.intro:
Oli Mchezaji {player_id} ({role}) mu mchezo wa Matching Pennies wa mizunguko {num_rounds}.
- Mzunguko mmoja mmoja, tuma [heads] au [tails] (au [h], [t]).
- Ikiwa chaguo lako linafanana na la mpinzani wako, Mchezaji 0 anashinda mzunguko; vinginevyo Mchezaji 1 anashinda.
Jibu na chaguo lako katika mfumo wa '[heads]' au '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mchezaji 0 alichagua {choice0}; Mchezaji 1 alichagua {choice1}. Fanana -> Mchezaji 0 anashinda
message.round_mismatch: Omuzannyi 0 yalonda {choice0}; Omuzannyi 1 yalonda {choice1}. Mismatch -> Omuzannyi 1 awangula.
